description: Feature store rows (L1). A changed definition is a new feature_id; rows are never rewritten. available_at is the earliest time the value could have been computed from data that existed then; readers filter on available_at <= decision time.

columns.name: event_at
columns.description: Time the feature describes (e.g. bar close).

columns.name: available_at
columns.description: max(ingested_at or availability of every input row) plus compute latency; must be >= event_at.
